name: diorama-slides
description: Turn an article, history, report or table into a short video where a still card of words (headline, figure, units, dated source) sits over a living 2.5D toy-diorama stage: one subject changing form era by era, drawn from your source's own nouns, with one fixed camera angle that pans and zooms on the world only. Between slides and a film: for stories where the thing itself changes, not for slide-style explainers with charts (explainer-video) or a cinematic 3D film (documentary-video). 15–60 s in 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9, in the same design system as chart-dashboard. Every figure comes from your source with its hedges kept. One standalone HTML file that exports MP4 in your browser: no other apps, no CDN, works offline; never posts.
